What benchmarks does Qwen3 Max score well on?
Qwen3 Max has been evaluated across 6 different signals.

Is Qwen3 Max available for free?
Qwen3 Max is a paid model, though some providers may offer trial credits or limited free tiers for evaluation. Check Alibaba's website for current free tier availability and promotional offers.
What is the context window for Qwen3 Max?
Qwen3 Max supports a 262K token context window (262,144 tokens total).
That translates to roughly 196,608 words in a single prompt. This is large enough to process entire codebases, research papers, or long conversation histories in one shot.
How long can Qwen3 Max responses be?
Qwen3 Max can generate up to 66K output tokens (65,536 tokens) per response. That is roughly 49,152 words.
